query: For my 42-year-old male, among men 37–47 receiving inpatient DAPT, what is the SD of in-hospital mortality (first admission)?
final_sql:
WITH first_admissions AS (
            SELECT subject_id, MIN(admittime) AS first_admittime
            FROM admissions
            GROUP BY subject_id
